name: content-aware-st
description: This app demonstrates content-aware cropping using Cloudinary's AI capabilities

paragraphs: This project showcases how to build a content-aware application using Streamlit and Cloudinary. The application allows users to process both images and videos using Cloudinary's powerful AI-driven content-aware cropping and delivery capabilities. Users can input any Cloudinary public ID for images or videos, select from multiple aspect ratios, and instantly preview the results. With Cloudinary, you can easily deliver media to perfectly fit your graphic design and layout, on any device.
features: Image Cropping: Input any Cloudinary image public ID and select from aspect ratios (1:2, 5:2, 1:1) for AI-powered content-aware cropping.
Video Cropping: Input any Cloudinary video public ID and select from aspect ratios (1:2, 5:2, 1:1) for AI-powered content-aware cropping.
Dynamic Media Delivery: Images and videos are processed and delivered via Cloudinary, ensuring optimal performance and responsiveness.
User-Friendly Interface: Easily preview the results and experiment with different aspect ratios and media types.
